inputs.style:
New Wave of British Heavy Metal, high energy, galloping tempo. Dominant electric bass lead with deep growl, driving double-bass drum kit, twin lead guitars with heavy distortion, powerful operatic male vocal performance, epic and dark atmosphere.
Choose the complete song's natural length and structure yourself. There is no required target duration. The safety ceiling is 900 seconds, not a goal to fill. Compose a coherent intro, verses, chorus and resolved final outro with final chord decay and silence. Finish all sung words and then end the song naturally. No endless loop or unfinished solo. Write explicit measures, no repeat signs.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
The frost bit deep into the deck
Where the shadows long and thick
We sailed beyond the map’s edge
Chasing the phantom edge
The wind screamed through the rigging
A cold and hollow crying
I raised my hand to the sky
And cut the bird that flew by
The eye was dead, the soul was bare
The air grew thick with despair

[Chorus]
Tide of the Iron Siren
Call us to the dark
Tide of the Iron Siren
Torn from the dark
Hearts of stone and bone
We roam alone
Tide of the Iron Siren
Pulling us home

[Verse]
The sails were white as bone
But we were never alone
They came from the foam below
With a cold and heavy flow
The moon was a silver coin
To buy our wandering pain
We danced with the ghostly dead
In the mist of the sea’s bed
The water was black and still
And the stars began to fall

[Chorus]
Tide of the Iron Siren
Call us to the dark
Tide of the Iron Siren
Torn from the dark
Hearts of stone and bone
We roam alone
Tide of the Iron Siren
Pulling us home

[Bridge]
And the water was like a glass
Reflecting our past
Every face in the deep
Weeping with no sleep
I reached out to the wave
But the hand of death was grave
The siren sang a song
Where the light is gone

[Verse]
Now the ship is drifting free
On the edge of eternity
The crew is gone, the mast is bent
We are not what we have spent
The bass hums in the hull
A low and mournful call
Waiting for the shore
Where the light returns once more

[Outro]
Tide of the Iron Siren
Call us to the dark
Tide of the Iron Siren
Pulling us home
